description: Buddy Phase 26 — Observability & State Integrity. Phase 25 activated disabled modules and hardened risk enforcement. Phase 26 adds observability to critical decision points and hardens state management. Theme: operators need visibility into WHY trades are blocked, agents are degrading, weights are oscillating, and thresholds are drifting. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Portfolio risk violation alerting with observation logging
userStories.description: Portfolio risk gates silently block trades without observability. Add detailed logging when trades are rejected due to portfolio risk limits.
acceptanceCriteria: In execution.py _check_portfolio_risk_limit() and _check_projected_portfolio_risk(), log to observation_log category='portfolio_risk_block' when rejecting
Include metadata: projected_risk_pct, current_nav, open_exposure_by_pair, would_be_lots, pair
Non-blocking — never crash on observation logging failure
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Added observation logging at both portfolio risk rejection points in execute_trade(). Logs to category='portfolio_risk_block' with gate type, pair, reason. Non-blocking with try/except.

userStories.title: Agent degradation early-warning via z-score monitoring
userStories.description: Agents can degrade from 55% to 35% over 15 trades without any alert. Add rolling z-score monitoring.
acceptanceCriteria: In agent_lifecycle.py, add method check_degradation() computing z-score vs 30-trade baseline
Flag agent with warning when z-score < -1.5
Include metadata: agent_name, baseline_rate, current_rate, z_score, trades_since_baseline
Wire into continuous.py every 5 cycles
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Added check_degradation() method using binomial z-score (10-trade recent vs 30-trade baseline). Wired into continuous.py step 3b-ii every 5 cycles. Logs agent_degradation_warning observations with full stats.

userStories.title: RL weight oscillation damping with EMA smoothing
userStories.description: Agent weights oscillate rapidly between regimes. Add EMA-based smoothing to weight updates.
acceptanceCriteria: In agents/_team.py update_weights_from_outcome(), apply EMA blending
Track per-agent weight_update_variance in _meta over 20-trade rolling window
When variance > 0.05, increase EMA blending for damping
Log weight_oscillation_detected when variance crosses threshold
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Applied EMA smoothing (0.7/0.3 blend) to both regime and global weight updates. Tracks per-agent weight_history and variance in _meta. When variance > 0.05, increases damping to 0.6/0.4 blend.

userStories.title: JSON state corruption validation and safe defaults
userStories.description: safe_json.py recovers from corruption but doesn't validate structure. Add schema validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add validate_agent_weights() checking for _global dict with float values
Add validate_trade_journal() checking entries have required fields
In safe_json_read(), after loading, run validator; if fail, try .bak then defaults
Log state_corruption_recovered observation
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Added validate_agent_weights() and validate_trade_journal() validators. Registered in _VALIDATORS dict keyed by filename. Integrated validation into safe_json_read() — on schema fail, tries .bak, then returns default with logging.

userStories.title: Gate threshold drift velocity monitoring
userStories.description: ThresholdOptimizer can drift thresholds without alerting. Add drift velocity tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Track threshold_change_history per gate
Compute drift velocity over consecutive changes
When velocity > 0.01/cycle for 3+ changes, log threshold_drift_alert
Include metadata: gate_name, velocity, direction, cumulative_delta
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Added _check_drift_velocity() method called after every optimize_thresholds(). Tracks per-gate change history (last 20), computes velocity over last 3 changes. Alerts when > 0.01/cycle with observation logging.

userStories.title: Correlation block enrichment with blocking pair context
userStories.description: Phase 25 US-152 blocks correlated pairs but logs minimal context. Enrich with blocking pair P/L and duration.
acceptanceCriteria: For each conflicting pair, fetch current P/L and time_open from open trade data
Add blocking_pair_detail to observation metadata
Track pair conflict frequency in _correlation_block_counts
Log enhanced metadata to observation_log
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Enhanced US-152 correlation block with blocking_pair_detail (P/L, units, open_time per conflicting trade). Added _correlation_block_counts dict tracking conflict frequency by pair combination. All data flows to observation_log metadata.
